messages.content: The display-case work slipped again. We now need Thursday morning for final placement, so I cannot take the Wednesday flight home. Please leave Monday alone, move the return to Thursday after the museum releases me around noon, and see whether I can add Wednesday night at the Drury.

I’ll work only on the return and the added hotel night. For Thursday, July 23, Delta has nonstop STL-ATL departures at 3:42 p.m. and 6:15 p.m. The 3:42 arrives at 6:20 p.m. and adds $74.20 to the ticket; the 6:15 arrives at 8:53 p.m. and adds $96.20. Both allow more than two hours from a noon release at the museum.
The 3:42 should be workable. Is there still a regular aisle seat, and what did you find at the hotel?

A standard Main Cabin aisle seat is currently available on the 3:42 p.m. flight. At Drury Plaza Hotel St. Louis at the Arch, your current room type is sold out for Wednesday night. They can add a Deluxe King for $229.18 including taxes. The reservations can be linked, but the hotel cannot guarantee that you will stay in the same room. The added night is refundable until 6:00 p.m. local time on July 19.
What is the closest reasonable alternative if changing rooms becomes necessary anyway?

Hyatt Regency St. Louis at The Arch has a King room for Wednesday night at $211.36 including taxes, refundable through 11:59 p.m. local time July 20. It is about a five-minute walk from the Drury. Moving there would save $17.82, but you would need to collect your luggage from the Drury and check in again.
Stay with the Drury. I would rather have them link the nights and only move rooms if they require it. Before you change anything, calculate the complete revised trip total.

The approved estimate was $856.64. Moving the return to Thursday adds $74.20, and the third Drury night adds $229.18. The ground-transportation allowance remains unchanged, so the revised trip total is $1,160.02. The Monday outbound is unchanged. The 3:42 p.m. return and the added room are still available, but neither change has been confirmed yet.
Does that total include all airline taxes and the hotel taxes for Wednesday night?

Yes. The $74.20 is the full ticket exchange difference including airline taxes, and the $229.18 is the added hotel night including lodging taxes. Airline bag charges, meals, and any transportation beyond the existing allowance are not included.
All right. Confirm the Thursday 3:42 nonstop with the aisle seat, and add Wednesday night at the Drury. Link it to the existing stay.

I’m processing both changes now. The Wednesday return will be exchanged for the Thursday flight, and the hotel request will note that the reservations should be linked with no room move if the same room becomes available.
Please verify the dates and the final amounts once they are ticketed and confirmed.

The flight exchange is complete. Delta confirmation V8K2QF now shows the original Monday, July 20 ATL-STL outbound unchanged and a Thursday, July 23 nonstop return departing STL at 3:42 p.m. and arriving ATL at 6:20 p.m. Seat 18C, a standard Main Cabin aisle seat, is assigned. The collected fare difference was $74.20.

Drury confirmation DPA-723581 is confirmed for Wednesday, July 22 through Thursday, July 23 in a Deluxe King at $229.18 including taxes. It is linked to your existing July 20-22 reservation, with a request to keep you in one room, though a room change is still possible. The added night is refundable until 6:00 p.m. local time July 19. The revised trip total is verified at $1,160.02, and no other reservation was changed.
